name: Sun Cleric Vow of Radiance adds 25% to Radiance's healing as to its damage (#9135)
contract: Vow of Radiance 803489 reads 'Direct ability damage or healing generates 2 Solar Power and damages or heals for an additional $s2% of the amount' (s2 = 25). Radiance 800054 bursts every 2 s through 800038, one spell that heals nearby allies (effect 0) and damages nearby enemies (effect 1). With a wounded grouped ally and an enemy in range, each Radiance burst is a direct heal and a direct hit, so the ally receives the 803816 copy for 25% of Radiance's effective healing, as the enemy takes an 803490 copy of the damage half. The heal ratio allows truncation of the percentage to whole points; the damage copy is only counted because the Holyfire hit can be partially resisted.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Vow of Radiance is active
Let the Vow's global cooldown expire
Leave room for Radiance's heals and their copies
SETUP: a Radiance burst heals the ally
SETUP: a Radiance burst hits the enemy
Vow of Radiance adds 25% of Radiance's effective healing
CONTROL: Radiance's damage half also gets its Holyfire copy
